meta.title: OneClickVirt
meta.description: Manage VMs, containers and nodes from DeepSeek Harness.

subtitle: Your virtual infrastructure, within reach
rememberHint: Password sign-in creates a permanent API token for this device and revokes it on sign-out. An existing token is saved without changing its expiry and is not revoked. Passwords are never saved. If the account token limit is reached, use an existing token or turn this off.
allowHTTP: Allow unencrypted HTTP for this deployment (credentials travel without encryption)
revokeWarning: Local sign-in was cleared, but the device token could not be revoked. Remove the DSH token in the platform Profile → API Tokens.
retryLogin: The saved login could not be verified. Check connectivity and retry.
submitted: Submitted. Check Tasks and the instance state to confirm completion.
selectImage: Choose an image from the selected node catalog.
name: Name
createHint: Images and specification IDs come from the selected node. Quotas, availability and permissions are still checked by OneClickVirt.
defaultNetwork: Leave network type blank to use the platform default.
sidebarHint: When hidden, reopen it from the sidebar More menu.
persistent: Sign-in is saved on the DSH host
hostHint: Credentials stay on the DSH host, in its credentials provider or a private plugin file. Browser storage contains only UI preferences and creation choices. Sign out before uninstalling to clear the saved login.
headless: CLI / CI uses the same native tools. Set the two environment variables below on the DSH host; never paste credentials into chat.
aliasHint: Up to 128 characters. Clear to display the original name. Search and host identifiers keep using the original name.
deleteHint: This permanently deletes the instance. Enter its exact original name to confirm.
logsHint: The current API provides instance state and task errors; it does not expose guest logs.
taskHint: Status refreshes every 10 seconds while this page is visible. An accepted task can still fail.
